intuition: A literal or dot consumes one matching character, while a star can either erase its preceding token or repeat it.

brute_force.approach: Recursively branch over each matching token and all valid repetition counts for stars.

optimal.approach: Use prefix DP; for star, combine the zero-occurrence state two pattern positions back with a one-more-match state in the same star column.

edge_cases: An empty string matches only patterns reducible to empty through star pairs.
A dot matches any one character, but a star modifies only its preceding token.
